description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우표정보 발행정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2021년도에 대한민국 우정사업본부에서 발행한 기념우표의 목록을 포함하고 있으며, 각 우표의 발행일, 우표명칭, 발행 종수(디자인 수)를 주요 항목으로 제공한다. 우표 주제는 천리안 위성, KAIST 50주년, 문화재 환수, 한국의 전통 건축(서원), 항공기 시리즈 등 국가의 주요 과학·문화·역사적 사건... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 발행일, 우표명칭, 종수, 기념우표, 문화유산. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
